parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Globally enables or disables the entire file transfer service managed by this object. When disabled, no file transfers will occur, regardless of individual profile or transfer configurations.

parameters.name: ProtocolsSupported
parameters.description: Indicates the protocols that are supported.

parameters.name: TypesSupported
parameters.description: Indicates the file types that are supported for upload.

parameters.name: HTTPCompressionsSupported
parameters.description: Indicates the HTTP Compression mechanism(s) supported by this Device for the purposes of transferring the data.

parameters.name: HTTPMethodsSupported
parameters.description: Indicates the HTTP method(s) supported by this Device for the purposes of transferring data.

object.description: This object serves as the central control for managing file uploads to a remote server. It allows for periodic transfers of various file types, such as logs, crash dumps, and kernel oopses. Individual upload configurations are defined within instances of the {{object|Profile}} object.
